changelog:
- Initial release of DGX Spark setup skill.
- Provides a step-by-step guide for configuring an NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10 Blackwell, 128GB unified memory) as a local LLM inference server using vLLM, LiteLLM, and OpenClaw.
- Covers requirements and instructions for building custom PyTorch and Triton with sm_121 (Blackwell) GPU compatibility.
- Includes guidance on setting up LiteLLM with per-user virtual keys, running as a systemd user service, and configuring Tailscale for secure remote access.
- Offers troubleshooting information and pointers for resolving compatibility issues (torch, Triton, flashinfer).
